title: Cardiac Rehab Referral Nudges
summary: Investigators will evaluate the effectiveness of two different EHR-embedded nudges to improve referral to cardiac rehabilitation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age of at least 18 years
* History of Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG), Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI), or valve repair/replacement in the past year

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hospice
* Active home health
